use_cases.name: Administer a retention bonus plan with vesting and clawback
use_cases.goal: Award deferred and retention bonuses under a plan with vesting conditions and clawback terms, pay each vested tranche through payroll and recover unearned amounts on early exit.

stakeholders.interest: Knows exactly when each tranche vests, what conditions apply and what is repayable if they leave early.
Approves awards against a fixed plan budget and sees any clawback waiver as a named exception.
Accrues the deferred liability each month and sees it released when tranches are paid or forfeited.
Receives vested tranches as ordinary payroll inputs, never as payments outside the run.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations launches a retention plan, for example to retain skilled machinists during the Medchal Works capacity ramp-up.
preconditions: A plan is configured with budget, eligible population, vesting schedule, vesting conditions and clawback terms.
Performance ratings and employment status are available to the eligibility service.
Payroll inputs can be raised for the employee's payroll group.
postconditions_success: Each award has an accepted letter, a vesting schedule in the ledger and, once vested, a payroll input in a named run.
Clawback assessments on exit are approved and recovered through the final settlement.
postconditions_failure: Awards rejected at approval create no schedule or liability.
Tranches whose conditions are not met are forfeited with the failed condition recorded.

main_flow.action: Creates the plan Medchal ramp-up retention 2026: 40% vests at 12 months and 60% at 24 months, subject to service and rating of 3 or above.
Nominates employees with award amounts; the platform checks the batch total against the plan budget of ₹48,00,000.
Submits the award batch to the approval engine with plan terms and budget utilisation.
Approves the batch.
Issues award letters from the plan template; each employee accepts in self-service, recording acceptance of the clawback terms.
Creates vesting tranches in the ledger and publishes the monthly deferred-liability accrual to Finance.
On each vesting date, the eligibility service checks active status, rating and absence of a pending resignation.
Raises a payroll input for each vested tranche into the next open run of the employee's payroll group.
Processes the run; the payslip shows the tranche as a separate earning with tax withheld under payroll rules.
On exit within the clawback window, computes the recoverable amount and routes it for approval and recovery in the final settlement.

alternate_flows.condition: An employee's rating for the period is 2.
steps: The eligibility service marks the condition unmet.
The tranche is forfeited or deferred to the next vesting date as the plan specifies, and the employee is notified.
alternate_flows.rejoin: Returns to step 8 for the remaining employees

alternate_flows.condition: The director waives clawback for an employee leaving on medical grounds.
steps: Director records the waiver with reason; the platform names the clawback term being waived.
No recovery is raised and the waiver is kept with the award.

exception_flows.condition: The nominated total exceeds the plan budget.
exception_flows.handling: The batch cannot be submitted and the excess amount is shown.
No awards, letters or tranches are created and HR operations is notified with the reason.

exception_flows.condition: The target payroll run is already finalised.
exception_flows.handling: The input is placed in the next open run and the payroll manager is notified.

exception_flows.condition: The recoverable amount exceeds the net payable in the final settlement.
exception_flows.handling: The shortfall is recorded as a receivable and passed to Finance for follow-up.

nfrs: Vesting evaluation is idempotent: rerunning it for a date never raises a second payroll input for the same tranche.
The monthly deferred-liability report reconciles to the sum of unvested tranches to the rupee.

user_stories.want: to see my retention award, vesting dates and clawback terms in one place
user_stories.so_that: I understand what I will receive and what I would repay if I left

acceptance.given: E1056 accepted a ₹2,00,000 award on 2026-12-01 vesting 40% at 12 months and 60% at 24 months
acceptance.then: she sees ₹80,000 vesting on 2027-12-01 and ₹1,20,000 on 2028-12-01 with the clawback terms

acceptance.given: E1056 has not yet accepted the award
acceptance.then: she must accept the clawback terms before the award shows as active

user_stories.want: vested tranches to arrive as payroll inputs in the correct run
user_stories.so_that: bonus payments follow the same controls as salary

acceptance.given: E1056's first tranche of ₹80,000 vests on 2027-12-01 and the December run is open
acceptance.then: one payroll input of ₹80,000 appears in the December run

acceptance.given: vesting is evaluated again for the same date

user_stories.want: the deferred bonus liability accrued each month
user_stories.so_that: the books reflect obligations that have been promised but not yet paid

acceptance.given: ₹48,00,000 of awards with 24-month vesting are active
acceptance.then: the accrual equals the earned portion of unvested tranches for the month
the accrued liability for that tranche is reversed

use_cases.name: Benchmark pay internally and flag outliers before a revision cycle
use_cases.goal: Compare pay within role, grade, location and tenure bands using internal data and route outliers into the next compensation revision cycle.

stakeholders.interest: Is paid consistently with colleagues doing comparable work at the same site and tenure.
Enters the revision cycle knowing which team members sit outside their band.
Sees the cost of correcting outliers before approving the cycle budget.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations prepares for the annual revision cycle or runs an ad-hoc check after a wage settlement at a plant.
preconditions: Compensation analytics projections are refreshed within the last 24 hours.
Grade pay ranges with midpoints exist for every grade in scope.
The user holds a compensation grant covering the selected entities and locations.
postconditions_success: Benchmark cells, outliers and HR notes are saved as a dated benchmark run.
Outliers tagged for correction appear as pre-cycle recommendations in the revision worksheet.
postconditions_failure: Cells below the minimum group size are suppressed and never exported.
Users without a compensation grant see headcounts only.

main_flow.action: Selects role family CNC machinist, grades S2 to S4, locations Chakan, Peenya and Oragadam, and tenure bands 0–2, 2–5 and 5+ years.
Reads the compensation analytics projection, limited to the entities and locations in the user's grant.
Computes for each cell the 25th percentile, median, 75th percentile and compa-ratio to grade midpoint.
Suppresses cells with fewer than 5 employees and marks them as insufficient size.
Flags outliers: compa-ratio below 0.85 or above 1.20, and inversions where newer joiners earn more than longer-tenured peers.
Reviews each outlier, records a reason such as skill premium or legacy structure, and tags those to correct.
Adds tagged outliers with proposed correction amounts to the revision worksheet as pre-cycle recommendations.
Reviews the total correction cost alongside the cycle budget.
Sees, during the cycle, each team member's band position without names or pay of people outside the team.

alternate_flows.condition: The user chooses to normalise for location.
steps: Platform applies the configured location differential before computing compa-ratios.
Results show both raw and location-adjusted figures.

exception_flows.condition: The projection was last refreshed more than 24 hours ago.
exception_flows.handling: A stale-data banner appears and export is disabled until the projection refreshes.

exception_flows.condition: The user lacks a compensation grant.
exception_flows.handling: Amounts and ratios are hidden; only headcounts per cell are shown.

exception_flows.condition: A tagged employee already has an approved revision effective in the cycle.
exception_flows.handling: The recommendation is not added and HR operations is shown the existing revision.

nfrs: A benchmark for 3,000 employees across 5 sites returns within 5 s at p95.
Exports carry a watermark with the user's identity and are recorded in the audit trail.

user_stories.want: to see compa-ratio by grade, site and tenure for one role family
user_stories.so_that: I can spot inconsistent pay before the revision cycle opens

acceptance.given: grade S3 has a midpoint of ₹3,60,000 a year and E1034 at Peenya Works earns ₹2,88,000
acceptance.when: I run the CNC machinist benchmark
acceptance.then: E1034 is flagged with compa-ratio 0.80, below the 0.85 floor

acceptance.given: the cell S4 at Oragadam with 5+ years has 3 employees and a minimum size of 5
acceptance.then: that cell is suppressed and shown as insufficient size

user_stories.want: to see pay inversions between new joiners and experienced staff
user_stories.so_that: I can correct compression created by recent hiring

acceptance.given: E1068 joined Chakan Works in 2026 at ₹3,40,000 and E1021 with 6 years earns ₹3,20,000 in the same grade
acceptance.then: the pair is flagged as an inversion

acceptance.given: I tag E1021 for correction with ₹30,000
acceptance.then: a pre-cycle recommendation of ₹30,000 appears for E1021 in the revision worksheet

user_stories.want: to see where my team sits in the pay band during the cycle
user_stories.so_that: I can make fair merit proposals

acceptance.given: I manage 12 machinists at Peenya Works
acceptance.then: I see each team member's band position and no data for employees outside my team

acceptance.given: one of my team has a pre-cycle recommendation
acceptance.then: the recommendation and HR's reason are shown

use_cases.name: Compute statutory bonus and gratuity under the published rule pack
use_cases.goal: Determine statutory bonus and gratuity eligibility and amounts from a published, legally validated rule pack, pay them through payroll and provide provisions to Finance.

stakeholders.interest: Receives the statutory bonus and gratuity due, with the working shown.
Maintains the registers required under the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 and the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 (to be validated by Legal).
Provides the allocable surplus and receives monthly provisions for both liabilities.
Declares the bonus rate within the permitted range for the accounting year.

use_cases.trigger: The accounting year closes for statutory bonus, or an employee's separation is recorded for gratuity.
preconditions: The Compliance owner has published the bonus and gratuity rule pack version for the accounting year after Legal validation, carrying eligibility thresholds, calculation ceiling, minimum and maximum rates, minimum working days and the gratuity service threshold, formula and ceiling.
Attendance days and wage components for the year are final in the ledger.
Form F nominations are recorded for employees in service.
postconditions_success: Bonus and gratuity amounts are paid through payroll inputs and recorded in the statutory registers with their working.
Monthly provisions are available to Finance for posting.
postconditions_failure: Computation does not start against an unpublished or unvalidated rule pack.
Ineligible employees are listed with the failed criterion and no payment is raised.

main_flow.action: Starts the statutory bonus computation for Vindhya Precision Industries Pvt Ltd for accounting year 2025-26.
Loads the published rule pack version and confirms it carries Legal validation.
The eligibility service tests each employee for wage threshold, minimum working days from the attendance ledger and exclusions.
Enters the allocable surplus for the year with supporting reference.
Declares the bonus rate within the rule pack's minimum and maximum through the approval engine.
Computes each bonus as rate times eligible salary capped at the calculation ceiling for the months worked, and shows the working.
Raises payroll inputs into the bonus payment run and generates the statutory bonus register.
For each separation, computes gratuity as 15/26 of last drawn basic plus DA times completed years, capped at the configured ceiling.
Passes the gratuity amount to the final settlement, paying the Form F nominee in case of death.
Publishes monthly bonus and gratuity provisions to Finance for accrual posting.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee has less than the service threshold but separates because of death or disablement.
steps: The eligibility service waives the service threshold as the rule pack specifies.
Gratuity is computed on actual completed service.

alternate_flows.condition: Completed service includes a part year above the rule pack's rounding limit.
steps: The part year is rounded up to a full year as configured, and the rounding is shown in the working.

exception_flows.condition: The rule pack for the year is published but not marked Legal-validated.
exception_flows.handling: The computation cannot start and the Compliance owner is alerted.

exception_flows.condition: An employee worked fewer than the minimum days in the year.
exception_flows.handling: The employee is listed as ineligible with the day count; no bonus is raised.

exception_flows.condition: The declared rate lies outside the rule pack's range.
exception_flows.handling: Approval cannot be submitted and the permitted range is shown.

exception_flows.condition: The director rejects the declared rate.
exception_flows.handling: No bonus inputs are raised and Finance and the payroll manager are notified.

nfrs: Every computed amount stores the rule pack version and inputs so it can be recomputed identically.
The annual bonus computation for 3,000 employees completes within 10 minutes.

user_stories.want: to compute statutory bonus for the whole entity in one run with eligibility shown
user_stories.so_that: I can pay bonus correctly and explain every exclusion

acceptance.given: the rule pack for 2025-26 is published and Legal-validated with a minimum working-day requirement of 30 days
acceptance.then: E1022, who worked 24 days after joining, is listed ineligible with 24 days shown

acceptance.given: the director has declared a rate of 8.33% within the configured range
acceptance.then: each eligible employee's working shows rate, capped salary and months, and payroll inputs are raised in the bonus run

user_stories.want: to see how my gratuity was calculated at exit
user_stories.so_that: I can trust the final settlement

acceptance.given: E1019 separates on 2026-11-30 after 7 years 8 months with last drawn basic plus DA of ₹26,000
acceptance.then: the working shows 15/26 × ₹26,000 × 8 years = ₹1,20,000 with the rounding of 8 months noted

acceptance.given: E1019 had 4 years 2 months of service and resigned
acceptance.then: no gratuity is raised and the unmet service threshold is shown

user_stories.want: statutory registers produced from the same computation that paid employees

acceptance.given: the 2025-26 bonus run has been paid
acceptance.then: each row matches the paid payroll input to the rupee

acceptance.given: a payroll input is reversed after payment
acceptance.then: the reversal is shown with date and reason
